blurb: The Biltmore Golf Course is a restored 18-hole, par-71 championship course originally designed in 1925 by Donald Ross and updated for modern play. It hosts the final qualifier of South Florida’s Junior Orange Bowl International Youth Golf Championship annually. The course is home to the University of Miami Women’s golf team and the Jim McLean Golf School, rated as the #1 Golf School in America.
